notes: Pune City Police publishes monthly absconder PDFs (CrPC §82) at https://admin.punepolice.gov.in/absconder_list. As of this scrape the latest PDFs we inspected (#83 (garbled=0.81), #82 (garbled=0.81)) are typeset in Marathi using the legacy DV-TTYogesh TrueType font whose embedded ToUnicode CMap maps glyphs to their private byte values rather than real Devanagari code points — pdf-parse, pdftotext (poppler) and pdfjs-dist all return garbled Latin-1 text. We have no reliable way to recover person names from these files without a hand-built DV-TTYogesh→Devanagari glyph table, so per our "never invent names" policy we ship an empty list and link to the official PDF. Latest PDF: https://admin.punepolice.gov.in/files/Absconder/83.pdf.
